inline:The target provides only a single resolution (Evolutionary Epistemology) without first constructing the required 'strongest case' for the opposing view (that the preference smuggles in induction), thereby failing the problem's structural constraints.
The problem explicitly demands a dialectical structure: argue Side A, argue Side B, then judge. The target jumps immediately to a specific synthesis (Side B via Evolutionary Epistemology) without demonstrating the strength of the counter-position (that Popper is inconsistent). This omission prevents the reader from evaluating whether the proposed solution actually survives the 'strongest case' against it, as mandated by the prompt.
